gate_surface.purpose: Expose one contract-owned gate surface that normalizes publish-time eligibility, remediation planning, bounded apply delegation, and post-apply convergence checks across the current docs/GitHub workflow family.
workflow_family: issue lifecycle conclusion and relationship repair
historical PR body rewrite and metadata backfill
source-log write-back and historical issue backfill planning

reused_existing_entrypoints.role: Issue-side audit plus remediation planning decision surface

reused_existing_entrypoints.kept_as: Mutation-family adapter behind the new gate surface
Mutation-family adapter behind the new gate surface
Mutation-family adapter behind the new gate surface
Publish-side preflight adapter behind the new gate surface

inputs: selection input: manifest, frozen audit plan, or contract-owned replay manifest
operation family: issue-conclusion, issue-relationship, pr-body-rewrite, pr-create-preflight, or backfill-only planning
source owner references: source_log_path, exact issue/pr refs, and explicit artifact output roots
policy profile: warning handling, reconciliation handling, and whether apply delegation is permitted
stages: optional remediation manifest planning for replayable findings
optional bounded apply delegation to a mutation-family adapter
required post-apply verify and convergence decision
outputs: zero or one remediation manifest artifact set
zero or one delegated apply result artifact
zero or one post-apply verify artifact with convergence decision

decision_rules.when: All selected findings are already pass or replayable and no blocking, manual, reconciliation, or input-error states remain.
decision_rules.next_step: Delegate only the bounded mutation family requested by the operator and require post-apply verify.

decision_rules.when: At least one selected finding is replayable but still unresolved, or any warning/manual work remains that should prevent publish/apply continuation.
decision_rules.next_step: Emit remediation artifacts and stop before mutation unless the chosen adapter has an explicitly approved narrow continuation rule.

decision_rules.when: The input set is malformed, ambiguous, or missing required ownership fields.
decision_rules.next_step: Do not plan remediation or apply; correct the input contract first.

decision_rules.when: Any explicit live-versus-source conflict survives classification or reappears during replay planning.
decision_rules.next_step: Require operator resolution of the winning source of truth before restarting the gate.

decision_rules.when: A delegated apply ran but post-apply verify shows incomplete convergence, new deterministic drift, or missing evidence.
decision_rules.next_step: Open a new bounded remediation cycle instead of looping with ad hoc live edits.

mutation_family_policy.continuation_rule: allow-apply or the existing narrow targeted-remediation continuation rule when relationship attach is the sole planned remediation family
preflight-only reuse; this gate does not collapse branch materialization, remote publish, or live PR publish into one atomic decision

explicit_non_goals: Do not widen the gate into generic prose quality review or summary rewriting.
Do not replace branch materialization, remote publish, or GitHub Actions secondary enforcement with one flat publish yes/no decision.
Do not infer blank issue_* or pr_* values while trying to make the gate more convenient.
Do not allow the new surface to bypass existing mutation-family-specific contracts.
recommended_rollout: First use the new surface as a naming and artifact contract that delegates to existing pre-gate adapters.
Then add one thin entrypoint that normalizes decision vocab and output paths without changing mutation-family behavior.
Only after that consider attaching the same surface to future publish-time automation or CI mirrors.
